title: Mike and palindrome
statementMd:
Mike has a string $*s*$ consisting of only lowercase English letters. He wants to **change exactly one** character from the string so that the resulting one is a palindrome.

A palindrome is a string that reads the same backward as forward, for example strings "`z`", "`aaa`", "`aba`", "`abccba`" are palindromes, but strings "`codeforces`", "`reality`", "`ab`" are not.

## Input

The first and single line contains string $*s*$ ($1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 15$).

## Output

Print "`YES`" (without quotes) if Mike can change **exactly** one character so that the resulting string is palindrome or "`NO`" (without quotes) otherwise.
statementZhMd:
Mike 有一个仅由小写英文字母组成的字符串 $*s*$。他希望**恰好修改**字符串中的一个字符，使得到的字符串成为回文串。

回文串是指正着读和反着读都相同的字符串，例如“`z`”、“`aaa`”、“`aba`”、“`abccba`”都是回文串，但“`codeforces`”、“`reality`”、“`ab`”不是回文串。

## 输入格式

第一行且仅有一行包含字符串 $*s*$（$1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 15$）。

## 输出格式

如果 Mike 可以**恰好修改**一个字符，使得到的字符串成为回文串，则输出“`YES`”（不含引号）；否则输出“`NO`”（不含引号）。
